headline: Make individual components safe to fail, useful to strangers and recoverable without any single account or maintainer.

basis.scope: GitHub Actions probe, same provider, 9/9 unit tests and five public checks on recovered attempt
18/18 deterministic tests, Pages workflow success, no R2 host readback
Explicit shared GitHub failure domain; no off-provider verified replacement
Source readback, not independent public reader
Six pinned specialist public source entries, all external receivers held
External self-described constellation and model/memory/execution/witness architecture; not reproduced inside CoCivium
Durable workflow retry, recovery and fairness pattern
Graph decomposition, checkpointer, interrupt and human approval pattern
Contributor absence and maintainer concentration measurement
Mirror backup source strategy requiring test restore

gates.name: Public source discoverability
gates.observation: Core repo GPL v3, source artifacts and intro page readable through GitHub
gates.next_proof: Independent audience retrieval and comprehension separate

gates.name: Canonical human front door
gates.observation: One external web route returned apex 404; www served dated CoInfra index
gates.next_proof: Independent second vantage and privacy-safe domain remediation

gates.name: Independent new user value
gates.observation: No qualifying first-use receiver with return/use outcome evidenced
gates.evidence: Specialist registry marks all receivers held
gates.next_proof: 5 consenting first-time completions, 2 voluntary returns; record outcome and correction

gates.name: Off-provider restore
gates.observation: CoRelay GitHub Pages, Raw, Actions and repository are one provider failure domain
gates.evidence: CoAcademy relay R1/R2 receipts and resilience.json
gates.next_proof: Cold restore exactly sourced public bundle to non-GitHub custody/host; receiver-produced hash and human retrieval

gates.name: Multi-host durable work continuity
gates.observation: CoStretch and virtual sessions have bounded tests; cross-power-domain running recovery unproven
gates.next_proof: Checkpoint, remove one host and resume elsewhere with leased authority and output parity

gates.name: Contributor independence
gates.observation: No verified independent maintainers or quantified contributor absence factor in this wave
gates.next_proof: Measure 90-day contributor-absence factor; a non-originator rebuilds, patches and closes a challenge

gates.name: Reuse rights and licensing
gates.observation: CoCivium root LICENSE is GPL-3.0; CoAcademy inspected root lacks top-level LICENSE
gates.evidence: GitHub root listing and source readback
gates.next_proof: Rights-holder inventory, per-file ownership/licence, NOTICE/third-party attribution and selected grant where authorized

gates.name: Observed independent audience funnel
gates.observation: Connected Metricool website URL blank; per-account social statistics not CoCivium reach
gates.next_proof: Privacy-safe entry/first-action/readback counts with bot/self controls and time windows

gates.name: External service/receiver pickup
gates.observation: GitHub Actions R1 external runner recovered HTTP checks after a Pages deployment race; R2 SHA tests passed CI without post-deploy serving verification
gates.evidence: CoRelay external R1 and R2 receipts plus Actions readbacks
gates.next_proof: Actual R2 seven-endpoint exact-byte HTTP result and separately controlled external reader/receiver ACK

gates.name: Model/adapter portability
gates.observation: Metadata and logical provider candidates exist, no full comparable accepted task on Claude/Pi/Llama/Ollama all verified
gates.next_proof: One open/local and one hosted adapter complete same permission-scoped task with portability/cost/quality evidence

gates.name: Security and privacy incident readiness
gates.observation: Domain legacy index warrants exposure audit; no independent security acceptance in current evidence
gates.next_proof: Verify public exposure, secrets, release rights, signed artifacts and recovery paths; test controlled takedown/rollback

gates.name: Community and governance succession
gates.observation: No proven independent steward rotation, dispute process or operations without primary developer
gates.next_proof: Non-originator can receive access, reject bad claim, rotate credential via safe process and release correction

gates.name: Spiffy specialist UX effectiveness
gates.observation: Six source-pinned routes and static checks pass, but no measured comparison against plain task-first default
gates.evidence: Specialist route registry and public first-use guide
gates.next_proof: Randomized consenting task trial; report completion/time/correction/privacy and participant choice

gates.name: Independent livelihood/legal sustainability
gates.observation: No audited budget runway, asset ownership, patent strategy or sustainable maintainer operations in this wave
gates.evidence: CoValue custody posture as candidate only
gates.next_proof: Private counsel/custodian ownership checks; a low-cost support budget with no public portfolio disclosure

stages.criterion: Public source, scoped demonstrations, disclosed limits
Verified safe human entry and one independently completed useful task
Second failure domain, cold restore, reproducible receiver readproof and non-originator operation

Five independent opted-in task completions, two voluntary returns, two independently functioning custodial domains, independent maintainer reproduction, tested disclosure/permissions, source rights and human-readable public route
Repeated outside contributions and independent governance, recovery and stewardship sustained over observation window

next_safe_deed: Owner review and independently verify public-domain privacy/routing, then attempt one no-secrets public bundle restore to a verified off-GitHub receiver with exact-object readback.

proof_semantics.PASS_BOUNDED: Exact narrow source/tool/readback succeeds inside named scope, not a general security or benefit proof
proof_semantics.FAIL_OBSERVED: One observed negative from a specified vantage; must be reproduced before claiming globally failing service
proof_semantics.PARTIAL_BOUNDED: At least one narrow stage observed; required stronger independent stage absent
proof_semantics.HELD: Permission/source/recovery/user data necessary to assert claim is missing
proof_semantics.UNKNOWN: No sufficiently scoped observation either way
proof_semantics.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Requires ownership/rights/permission review, not unilateral autopublishing or relicensing

notifications: No unsolicited mailing, no mass social posting, no autonomous ongoing watcher, no device mutation, no provider-account shutdown, no financial trades or legal filings
